A small sensor on the door of the Hollygrove Community Fridge will count each time the door opens. That is all it does: there is no camera, and it knows nothing about who stops by. The counts will show how much the fridge is used and when it most needs restocking.

The counter is built and being tested. It is not on the fridge yet.

## About the counter

**What is counted.** Each time the door opens, the sensor adds one to the count and notes roughly how long the door stayed open.

**What is not.** There is no camera and no microphone. The sensor does not see faces, phones or license plates, and it collects no names or personal information. The page shows totals by the hour, never the exact moment the door opened.

**A door opening is not a visitor.** One neighbor might open the door twice. A volunteer stocking the shelves might open it five times. Read the numbers as "how busy was the fridge," not "how many people came."
